Music

Spotify inside Regis.

Connect Spotify

  1. Open developer.spotify.com/dashboard, sign in, and press Create app.
  2. Name it Regis, add any description. Under Redirect URIs add the address below that matches how you use Regis, then tick Web API (and Web Playback SDK) and save.
  3. Open the app, then Settings. Copy the Client ID. You do not need the client secret.
  4. Paste the Client ID here and press Connect Spotify. Approve the permissions when Spotify asks.
Desktop app redirect URIhttp://127.0.0.1:8888/callback
Web / phone redirect URI (this page)

Spotify Premium is needed to control playback. If Spotify says you are not registered, add your own email under the app’s User Management.

Or just listen without signing in

Sign in inside the player for full songs; without it you hear 30-second previews.

Connect & Setup
Google account

Claude (for briefs, drafts, rules and Plan my day)

Canvas (school assignments)

In Canvas: Account → Settings → “+ New Access Token”. The token stays on this computer, encrypted, and is only sent to your school’s Canvas.

Sync across my devices

Uses one private file in your own Google Drive (“Regis sync (do not delete).json”). Turn this on in every Regis you use, signed in to the same Google account. Scheduled sends only fire from the device that scheduled them.

Updates

Updates arrive on their own: the web app and iPhone/iPad app update every time you open them, and the desktop app downloads new versions in the background. Nothing to reinstall unless the release notes say so.

Vault (passwords and private notes)

This computer

Closing the window keeps Regis running in the tray so Autopilot and scheduled sends keep working. Quit from the tray icon.

What you do
  1. In claude.ai open Settings → Connectors and add Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive (sign in with your Google account when asked).
  2. Open this page from your artifacts in claude.ai, then press the status pills at the top to connect. Approve each prompt.
  3. In Google Drive, create the folders you want files sorted into. Regis lists them in the filing rule form.
  4. Open Settings below and add your VIP senders so they are never auto-cleaned and always float to the top.
  5. Turn on a cleaning rule, press Preview, check the numbers, then Apply. Turn on Autopilot only after a rule has behaved well for a few days.
  6. Keep the link private. Only you can open this page’s data, but anyone with the link could open an empty shell.
What it can’t do (and why)
  • Run while closed. Autopilot, scheduled sends and syncing only run while this page is open in a tab. Scheduled background tasks are a paid-plan feature.
  • Send without asking. “Send now” needs a second click to confirm. Scheduled sends fire only while this page is open, and only the ones you set to send automatically.
  • Delete Drive files or empty Trash. Filing moves files and can be undone. Nothing is deleted.
  • Trash mail on autopilot. A rule may move mail to Gmail’s Trash (recoverable for 30 days) but only when you press Apply yourself.
  • Read AI balances. You log usage by hand or by command.
  • Create calendar events. Read-only for now.
